en.t: Ah, I have caught up with Sakurako, I have passed Sakurako! ...

units.source_text: 只有这一点，阿光清晰地意识到了。

en.t: This alone Akimitsu was clearly aware of.

units.source_text: 这当儿，两匹马儿的腹部相触，微微晃了几下，

en.t: Just then, the bellies of the two horses touched, and they swayed slightly a few times,

units.source_text: 马戏团明星樱子连同火焰的光圈一起，从马背上摔落下来了。

en.t: and Sakurako, the circus star, fell from the horse's back together with the ring of firelight.
